text.content:
If your eyes aren't Kiroshis, why did you get new eyes?

Industry: Cyberoptics: design and manufacture
In Night City: The Kiroshi Campus (#14) in Charter Hill; an optics salon in The View; outlets all over the city
Known for: The market leader in optics; sponsors the pop group Us Cracks

The industry leader in cybernetic eyes. Kiroshi's sponsorship of the Japanese pop group Us Cracks has made it a favorite with young buyers around the world. Its Charter Hill campus does optics R&D, and the gift shop sells last year's models at a discount.

Kiroshi is one of the three campus corps in the Charter Hill security consortium. Danger Gal's cat-ear sensor headsets carry Kiroshi optics in the ears.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.23; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 09
